Learned Additional Government Advocate is directed to take notice for respondent Nos.1 to 3. Sri.
Arunkumar Amargundappa, learned counsel is directed to take notice for respondent Nos.4 and 5.
2.
Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner.

3. This petition is filed seeking the following reliefs:
"(a). Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of writ of Mandamus, directing the respondent No.2 to consider the Representations dated 1.6.2022 given by the father of the petitioner vide Annexure-E1 submitted by the petitioner and to pass appropriate orders in accordance with law.

(b) Direct the respondents to initiate Acquisition proceedings forthwith and pay damage U/Sec.
19(1) R/w Sec. 19(2) of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Re-Settlement Act 2013 as done in similarly situated persons.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Re-Settlement Act 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: (c). Pass such other order or direction, this Hon'ble Court deems fit in the circumstance of the case."

4. It is the case of the learned counsel that petitioner is the absolute owner in possession of land bearing NC: 2026:KHC-K:869 HC-KAR Survey No.81 measuring 07 acres situated towards east of Sugur village, Yadgiri District.

It is the contention of the petitioner that in the earlier village map,
there was no road in the land.
It is only after 1993 onwards, respondent No.5 encroached the eastern corner of the land of the petitioner.

It is further contended that father of the petitioner submitted various representations to the respondent authorities requesting to pay compensation for having utilized the portion of the land belonging to him to an extent of 25 guntas in Survey No.81.
The respondent authorities have not initiated any action, neither the acquisition process is made nor compensation is paid.

It is further contended by the learned counsel for the petitioner that a representation came to be made by his father on 01.06.2022 to the Deputy Commissioner, Yadgiri,
to pay the compensation for the land utilized.

However, the Deputy Commissioner in turn,
addressed a letter to the Executive Engineer, Zilla Panchayat, Engineering Division, Assistant Executive Engineer, Panchayat, Engineering Division and the Tahsildar directing to verify and confirm as to whether any road is NC: 2026:KHC-K:869 HC-KAR constructed in the land of the petitioner.

The Tahsildar addressed a letter to the Assistant Executive Engineer, Zilla Panchayat,
Engineering Sub-Division, Shahapur, directing him to inform as to whether any road is formed in the land bearing Survey No.81 measuring 25 guntas.
However, the representation has not been considered.

Hence, the petitioner is before this Court invoking the writ jurisdiction under Articles Tammanna vs The State Of Karnataka on 3 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/183589475/
3 226 and 227 of the Constitution of India.

sentences.text: 5. Per contra, learned Additional Government Advocate representing the respondent-State and learned counsel for respondent Nos.4 and 5 submit that they would verify and ascertain as to whether the property of the petitioner is utilized at all and acquisition process is initiated and they will address the representation in accordance with law, if reasonable time is granted.

6. Placing the submission of the learned Additional Government Advocate and learned counsel for respondent Nos.4 and 5, this Court deems it appropriate to dispose of NC: 2026:KHC-K:869 HC-KAR the petition with a direction to the respondents to consider the representation of the petitioner.

7. Accordingly, I pass the following:
ORDER i.
This petition is allowed.

ii. The direction is issued to respondent Nos.2 to 5 to consider the representation dated 01.06.2022 submitted by the father of the petitioner at Annexure-E1 and pass suitable orders in accordance with law, within a period of three months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
iii. While considering the representation, respondent Nos.2 to 5 shall take into consideration Annexure-B filed by the petitioner in this petition.

Sd/-
